a11y_accesskey.summary: accesskey conflicts with screen reader and keyboard shortcuts.

a11y_aria_activedescendant_has_tabindex.summary: An element with aria-activedescendant must be focusable (have a tabindex).

a11y_aria_attributes.summary: Elements that cannot carry ARIA must not have aria-* attributes.

a11y_autocomplete_valid.summary: autocomplete value must be a valid token.

a11y_autofocus.summary: autofocus disorients screen reader and keyboard users.

a11y_click_events_have_key_events.summary: Clickable non-interactive elements need a keyboard handler.

a11y_consider_explicit_label.summary: Prefer an explicit label association over an implicit one.

a11y_distracting_elements.summary: marquee/blink are distracting and cannot be paused (non-interference criterion).

a11y_figcaption_index.summary: figcaption must be the first or last child of figure.

a11y_figcaption_parent.summary: figcaption must be a direct child of figure.

a11y_hidden.summary: This element should not be hidden from assistive technology.

a11y_img_redundant_alt.summary: alt text must not contain redundant words like "image" or "picture".

a11y_incorrect_aria_attribute_type.summary: aria-* attribute value does not match the expected type.

a11y_incorrect_aria_attribute_type_boole.summary: aria-* attribute must be a boolean value (true/false).

a11y_incorrect_aria_attribute_type_id.summary: aria-* attribute must reference a single element id.

a11y_incorrect_aria_attribute_type_idlis.summary: aria-* attribute must reference a space-separated list of element ids.

a11y_incorrect_aria_attribute_type_integ.summary: aria-* attribute must be an integer value.

a11y_incorrect_aria_attribute_type_token.summary: aria-* attribute must be one of a fixed set of token values.
aria-* attribute must be a space-separated list of token values.

a11y_incorrect_aria_attribute_type_trist.summary: aria-* attribute must be true, false, or mixed.

a11y_interactive_supports_focus.summary: Elements with an interactive role must be focusable.

a11y_invalid_attribute.summary: Attribute value is invalid (e.g. an href of just "#").

a11y_label_has_associated_control.summary: Labels must be associated with a form control (for/id or nesting).

a11y_misplaced_role.summary: This element cannot carry an ARIA role.

a11y_misplaced_scope.summary: scope attribute is only valid on table header cells.

a11y_missing_attribute.summary: This element is missing a required attribute (most commonly alt on img).

a11y_missing_content.summary: Heading/anchor elements must have discernible text content.

a11y_mouse_events_have_key_events.summary: onmouseover/onmouseout require onfocus/onblur for keyboard users.

a11y_no_abstract_role.summary: Abstract ARIA roles cannot be used directly.

a11y_no_interactive_element_to_nonintera.summary: Do not assign a non-interactive role to a naturally interactive element.

a11y_no_noninteractive_element_interacti.summary: Non-interactive elements should not have interactive event handlers without a supporting role.

a11y_no_noninteractive_element_to_intera.summary: Do not assign an interactive role to a naturally non-interactive, static element.

a11y_no_noninteractive_tabindex.summary: Non-interactive elements should not be in the tab order.

a11y_no_redundant_roles.summary: Redundant explicit roles (e.g. role="button" on button) add noise.

a11y_no_static_element_interactions.summary: Static elements with event handlers need an interactive role and keyboard support.

a11y_positive_tabindex.summary: Positive tabindex breaks the natural focus order.

a11y_role_has_required_aria_props.summary: Elements with an ARIA role must carry that role's required properties.

a11y_role_supports_aria_props.summary: aria-* attributes must be supported by the element's role.

a11y_role_supports_aria_props_implicit.summary: aria-* attributes must be supported by the element's implicit role.

a11y_unknown_aria_attribute.summary: aria-* attribute is not a recognized ARIA property.

a11y_unknown_role.summary: role value is not a valid ARIA role.

no-target-blank.summary: target="_blank" opens a new window without warning the user; pair with rel="noopener noreferrer" and consider avoiding it.
